title: Ten people charged in Paris over stolen gold-broker client files used in impersonation scam
date_note: ZATAZ says the Paris prosecutor announced the charges on 20 November 2026; the ZATAZ page itself gives no earlier day.
summary: ZATAZ reports that the Paris prosecutor announced on 20 November 2026 that ten people were charged (mises en examen). According to ZATAZ, files stolen from three precious-metals brokers were used to target their clients, with callers posing as employees or police officers. ZATAZ says four suspects were placed in pre-trial detention and six under judicial supervision.
plain: Ten people have been charged in Paris after data taken from three gold brokers was allegedly used to scam their clients. Four are in pre-trial detention.
exec: Stolen client data from precious-metals brokers was allegedly used to impersonate staff or police and target clients.

validation.note: Only ZATAZ was read; it relays the Paris prosecutor's communiqué, which was not read. ZATAZ says the communiqué names no companies or intrusion method.

evidence.quote: Le parquet de Paris a annoncé, le 20 novembre 2026, la mise en examen de dix personnes
Quatre suspects ont été placés en détention provisoire et six sous contrôle judiciaire.

review.note: Compared title, 20 Nov announcement, ten charged, 4 detained and 6 supervised, callers posing as staff or police against ZATAZ; single_source note correct
